Put raw images here, then run: python3 build/images.py
All images are made SQUARE except banner (900x500), popup (9:16) and og. Names: see build/images.py.
  banner, popup, app, logo, og
  games/<slug>           (GAMES in site_config.py)
  categories/<page key>  (games, slots, live, sports, fishing, table, fast, promotions, free-credit, vip, referral, lucky-draw, app)
  promos/<image name>    (promo-1 .. promo-4)
  posts/<post key>
